theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds Need Large Money: Myth Busted
body: You can start investing with minimal amounts. Systematic approaches allow gradual wealth building regardless of initial capital size.
caption: A common misconception is that mutual funds require large lump sums. In reality, flexible investment options make them accessible to everyone. Start small, invest regularly, and let your money grow over time. #MutualFundMyths #InvestingBasics #WealthBuilding #InvestmentTruths #FinancialLiteracy
